verses.1: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, my soul!
verses.2: Praise the LORD in my life; I will praise the LORD with all my heart.
verses.3: Do not trust the generous man in Adam, who has no help at all.
verses.4: His soul will return to its land on that day, when his ancestors are destroyed.
verses.5: May Yaakov be able to break free from his bondage to Jehovah, his God.
verses.6: He makes the heavens and the earth; He rules over the sea and over all that is in them. He keeps them forever.
verses.7: He makes judgments for the poor; he gives bread to the hungry. Jehovah forgives those who are guilty of sin.
verses.8: YHWH will open up the heavens. YHWH will lift up those who are righteous. YHWH loves the righteous.
verses.9: YHWH will protect the widows and orphans. He will also destroy the paths of the wicked.
verses.10: May the LORD reign forever, your God. May Zion and Jerusalem be blessed forever.
